item.title: Baqaei: US visa ban on Iranian president’s media team is an attempt to hide the truth
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says the Trump administration’s denial of visas to members of President Masoud Pezeshkian’s media team ahead of this week’s United Nations General Assembly is not an exercise in managing access; it is an attempt to conceal the truth and push a campaign of misinformation.

item.title: Interior Minister: Iran-Pakistan borders to operate around clock
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Emphasizing that relations between Iran and Pakistan are strategic and deep, Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni said that following bilateral agreements, the two countries' existing border crossings will operate around the clock, and a new crossing will be opened at Kuhak.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86270584/Interior-Minister-Iran-Pakistan-borders-to-operate-around-clock

Tehran, IRNA – Emphasizing that relations between Iran and Pakistan are strategic and deep, Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni said that following bilateral agreements, the two countries' existing border crossings will operate around the clock, and a new crossing will be opened at Kuhak.
